# PR #3807: Patch: a job ran over 7 minutes

Closes #3803

I only corrected a stale comment in `scripts/ci-shards.toml`. The fix for #3803 is already on `main`, and I can't tell from here whether it brings every shard under 5 minutes.

The slow run in the issue (`bot/issue-3777`, 2 shards) predates #3765 (`eef28c3240`), which set `smoke = 4`. I saw no timings from any `e2e smoke (k/4)` job, so whether each of the four shards now finishes under 5 minutes is unconfirmed.

**What changed:** the comment above `[e2e]` / `smoke = 4` still described seven SMOKE specs and an old deal. It now matches the eight SMOKE specs (`51` was added). It also records the 2-shard timings from #3764 and #3803. `smoke = 4` and every other line are untouched.

**How I checked:**
- `cd e2e && node scripts/shard-specs.mjs --smoke k 4` for k = 1..4 printed these deals, which the comment now states:
  - shard 1: `47`
  - shard 2: `46`
  - shard 3: `06`, `10`, `13`, `19`
  - shard 4: `01`, `51`
- `cd bot && python3 -m unittest tests.test_ci_matrix` ran 15 tests, all OK.

**Decisions:**
- I did not refresh `WEIGHTS` in `e2e/scripts/shard-specs.mjs`. Specs `46`, `47` and `51` are still estimates, and with no measured times, changing them would be guessing. The comment says to refresh them from the first `e2e smoke (k/4)` timings on `main`.
- I did not raise the count above 4. That would fail the pin in `bot/tests/test_ci_matrix.py`, which the bot may not edit.

**For a person:** once `e2e smoke (k/4)` timings exist on `main`, check them.
- If a shard still runs over 5 minutes, raise `smoke` in `scripts/ci-shards.toml` and update `bot/tests/test_ci_matrix.py` (the pin on line 75 and the `smoke = 4`/`smoke = 5` cases around lines 120–134) to match.

Opened by @github-actions[bot].

[CI run 43276797892](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43276797892) on `bot/issue-3777` (`8a8dfa5`, pull_request) had jobs over the 7-minute alert (#73):

| Job | Time | Result |
|---|---|---|
| [e2e smoke (1/2)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43276797892/job/131444367892) | 8m 13s | success |
| [e2e smoke (2/2)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43276797892/job/131444367943) | 7m 32s | success |

Split the slow job further until every job finishes under the 5-minute target, not just under the 7-minute alert, so the fix has headroom. Most splits are a count in `scripts/ci-shards.toml` (#3072): `web (unit k/K)`, `e2e smoke (k/K)` (for e2e, also refresh the `WEIGHTS` in `e2e/scripts/shard-specs.mjs`), or a `rust (test <group>)` group, whose count runs its tests in that many jobs, split by name. A count splits the run, not the compile: a group slow to compile needs its tests in more binaries (the engine's `rules_<n>` each get a job by themselves). Anything that cannot be made fast belongs in the daily `.github/workflows/super.yml`, not in CI.

Night bot: you cannot change `.github/`, and a count or a new `rules_<n>` needs no change there. When the split needs a new group or other flags in `.github/ci/rust-test.toml`, or any other change under `.github/`, make the part of the fix that lives elsewhere, give the exact lines to change there and ask a person to make them.

| File | Kind | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `scripts/ci-shards.toml` | change | Rewrite the comment above `[e2e]` / `smoke = 4`. It names "seven SMOKE specs" and a deal that no longer matches. `SMOKE` now has eight specs, with `51` added. |

   - 2: `46`
   - 3: `06`, `10`, `13`, `19`
   - 4: `01`, `51`

- `cd e2e && for k in 1 2 3 4; do node scripts/shard-specs.mjs --smoke $k 4; echo; done`.

- Has any `e2e smoke (k/4)` job run since #3765, and did every shard finish under 5 minutes? If a shard is still over, a person needs to do these:
  1. Edit `bot/tests/test_ci_matrix.py`. Change the assertion on line 75 to the new count list, and make the `smoke = 4` / `smoke = 5` edit in `test_a_count_on_a_fanned_out_group_shards_each_of_its_binaries` (lines 120–122) and the line-134 case match it.
  2. Then raise `smoke` in `scripts/ci-shards.toml` and refresh `WEIGHTS` in `e2e/scripts/shard-specs.mjs` from the measured Cypress durations of `46`, `47` and `51`.
  3. If one spec alone still takes over 5 minutes, move that spec from `SMOKE` to the daily `super.yml` run, which is also a person's job because it edits `.github/workflows/`.
